Privacy.title: Privacy information
Privacy.description: Which data we process when you use this website or write to us – and why.
Privacy.intro: This website has no online shop, no customer accounts and no payment function. We only process technically necessary data and the details you send us yourself.

sections.title: 1. Responsible party
paragraphs: The responsible party for data processing on this website is Gold Helwah, Inh. Khaled Helwah, Breite Straße 9, 66115 Saarbrücken, Deutschland, phone +49 173 537 1225, email info@goldhelwah.de.
If you have questions about privacy or wish to exercise your rights, you can contact us at any time.

sections.title: 2. Technical connection data
paragraphs: When you visit the website, technically necessary data such as IP address, date and time, browser information, and requested pages may be processed.
This processing is necessary to provide the website securely and reliably.

sections.title: 3. Contact and inquiry requests
paragraphs: If you contact us by contact form, email, phone, or WhatsApp, we process the information you provide only to handle your request.
The data processed depends on the subject of your request and the information you share with us.

sections.title: 4. Language preference and essential cookies
paragraphs: The website supports multiple languages and may store your selected language for technical reasons.
This information is used only to display the website in your preferred language on later visits.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to request information about your stored personal data and, where the legal requirements are met, to request correction, deletion, or restriction of processing.
You may also object to processing or withdraw previously granted consent with effect for the future.

Privacy.noticeText: We review this privacy information regularly and update it whenever our website, communication channels, or legal obligations change.
